reliability.rationale: Exact frozen numerical evidence reproduces, including losing controls; this verifies computation, not universal interpretation.

mechanism.rationale: Numerical replay does not identify a microscopic mechanism or validate signs of fitted empirical components.

novelty.rationale: No literature-priority adjudication in this computational review.

significance.rationale: Reusable scoped benchmark comparison. Complete reactor run. Diagnostic forecast after 300 min with fixed prefix calibration; no future conversion/selectivity predictors.; A two-parameter, causal prefix-conditioned forecast improves persistence and straight-line continuation on two reserved reactor runs. It loses to the flexible control and several other frozen candidates, so evidence supports useful short-horizon calibration rather than a superior or universal kinetic law.; No independent population confidence interval from dependent rows.

reproducibility.rationale: Native-source reconstruction and every saved model/metric passed independent computation.

impact.rationale: No independent deployed intervention/cost/safety outcome was measured.
